method: Manual landmarks read on actual retained256px source grids by three reviewers. Snap within8px only to an existing opaque native physical barrel/palm contour; exact RGBA and distance retained. Colored palm/ShockRifle emitters are explicit exceptions to neutral-metal filtering. Marker overlays are inspection artifacts only, never production sprites. One forefront visible integrated-minigun barrel projects the bounded authoritative projectile; its paired native cosmetic flash does not add another gameplay hit.

reviewedImportRoi.method: A native-source import rectangle encloses every pixel with alpha>24. Exact originalRGBA values inside that rectangle are retained, including alpha1..24. Only outer low-alpha fringe is excluded; no threshold alters a retained pixel. Original source-scale is frozen before this import, so other poses and all bases stay unchanged. Bottom aligns with median physical foot level of the three neighboring fatality poses, not with a stray alpha1 pixel.
